description: The SHARED runtime node: the tool layer + graph/encoder/build/audit operations as one IPP v0.2.8 component. invoke executes ANY registered tool (BaseTool four-phase lifecycle or the flat codex suite); list/describe expose the JSON-Schema definitions the LLM sees; graph materializes local graphs and reads/validates nodes; encoder runs vector RAG (search_nodes/search/ingest/save); build seeds/rebuilds graphs and exports; check runs the read-only audit suite (review/standard/advanced). The per-agent tools nodes (codex_*_tools, ManyAgents) resolve their invoke channel DOWNSTREAM to this node's invoke channel — one execution plane, one audit trail. External topology: constructor-resolved against 𝒢.

input.description: {tool: str, args: object, agent_id?, session_id?, workspace_root?} — one tool call

process.description: Execute one registered tool: IPP BaseTools through the four-phase lifecycle (resolve → validate → prepare → invoke) via the shared ToolRegistry, then the flat codex suite. Returns {ok, content, error, metadata}.

process.description: The tool JSON-Schemas for the LLM: registry (BaseTools win) merged with the flat codex suite, optionally restricted to `names` (agent-tailored tool sets).

input.description: {op: local|read|validate|summarize|stats|pagerank|registry, node_id?, depth?, focus?}

anyOf.description: Materialize the depth-k local graph (default 3) of a node — the agent's working memory.
Read a node's metadata: entryname, category, description, content refs, stats.
Run §4.3a consistency + health checks; report violations.
Produce a compact text summary of a node's local graph (community-style summary).

focus.description: what the summary should focus on

anyOf.description: Graph overview: node/edge counts, density, components, violations.

process.description: The agent's hands on the network: local depth-k graphs (working memory), node reads, §4.3a consistency validation, community-style summaries, graph stats, pagerank and the structurelist registry.

input.description: {op: search_nodes|search|ingest|save, query?, k?, node_id?, text?}

anyOf.description: Vector-based RAG search: find nodes and chunks similar to a query (encoder layer).
Raw vector search over chunks (web UI surface).
Index a node's text into the encoder layer.

process.description: Vector RAG over the encoder layer: search_nodes returns node hits + chunk evidence (the agent's tool), search returns raw chunks (the web UI), ingest_meta indexes a node's text, save persists the index.

input.description: {op: build|cy3|export, out_dir?, topic?}

anyOf.description: Seed the network from assets/ (build_graph) and rebind.
Seed a custom graph folder (build_cy3_graph) and rebind.

process.description: Graph seeding/rebuild and exports: build seeds the network from assets/ (build_graph), cy3 seeds a custom graph folder (build_cy3_graph), export writes the legacy per-topic exports.

input.description: {op: review|standard|advanced, workspace_root?}

anyOf.description: Scan the project for the top security threats / risks (exposed keys, secrets, dangerous patterns). READ-ONLY.
Standard project check: structure, required files, Python syntax, graph consistency. READ-ONLY.
Advanced audit: large files, stale artifacts, .env exposure, dependency pins, TODOs/FIXMEs. READ-ONLY.

process.description: The READ-ONLY audit suite: review scans for the top security threats (exposed keys, secrets, dangerous patterns); standard checks structure/required files/Python syntax/graph consistency; advanced audits large files, .env exposure, TODO/FIXME markers and dependency pins.
